before_departure_readability.verdict: FAIL under a strict image-first threshold. Before-departure is plausible, but not visually exclusive.

semantic_verdict.summary: The frame fixes several earlier defects: the elevator now has a real residual opening, exactly two hands are visible, Aachu's palm is on the same closed door, bodies are separate, copy and brandmark are clean, and a curved travel trail exists. It still must be rejected because the lever spindle is approximately 103-110 pixels, or 23-25 percent of the slab width, inboard from the right edge. The lockset again floats in the main door field instead of on the latch stile. The strict anatomical-left hand ownership and the full outward-then-return before-departure route are also not visually secured.
semantic_verdict.primary_failure: Ordinary door-hardware geometry has regressed: the lever is far too deep inside the door slab.
